definitions.explanation: a position title indicating responsibility for a particular area or function

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{営業|えいぎょう}{主任|しゅにん}に{昇進|しょうしん}した。
examples.english: She was promoted to sales supervisor.

examples.japanese: {主任|しゅにん}に{確認|かくにん}してから{決|き}めます。
examples.english: I'll decide after checking with my supervisor.

examples.japanese: {新人|しんじん}{研修|けんしゅう}の{主任|しゅにん}は{田中|たなか}さんです。
examples.english: Mr. Tanaka is in charge of new employee training.

notes:
USAGE:
- 〜{主任|しゅにん} (~ supervisor/chief)
- {主任|しゅにん}を{務|つと}める (to serve as supervisor)

COMMON COMBINATIONS:
- {営業|えいぎょう}{主任|しゅにん} (sales supervisor)
- {研修|けんしゅう}{主任|しゅにん} (training supervisor)
- {開発|かいはつ}{主任|しゅにん} (development chief)

JAPANESE CORPORATE HIERARCHY:
Typically: {平社員|ひらしゃいん} → {主任|しゅにん} → {係長|かかりちょう} → {課長|かちょう} → {部長|ぶちょう}
(Regular employee → Supervisor → Section chief → Manager → Department head)
